context: A teacher and student discuss a documentary on landscapes
purpose: Teach: 四季/蛇/蝶/鶴/鐘/線路/頂上/聖堂

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 昨夜のドキュメンタリー、四季を通して撮影された山の頂上、美しかったですね。
lines.en: That documentary last night was really beautiful—the way they filmed that mountain summit across all four seasons.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Gentle pace. Soft admiration in the voice. Inviting him to remember it with her, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。古い聖堂の鐘の音も収録されていました。
lines.en: Yeah. They even recorded the old chapel bells up there.
lines.style: Quiet enthusiasm. A small nod of confirmation. Leaning slightly forward with genuine interest. The gentle eagerness of someone who actually paid close attention.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蛇や蝶、自然の生態、丁寧に描写していました。
lines.en: The snakes, butterflies—everything in the ecosystem was captured so carefully and respectfully.
lines.style: Thoughtful pace, slightly slower on the list. Appreciative breath. Voice carrying the care she noticed in the filmmaking itself. Present and attentive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地元では、線路沿いに鶴が舞うシーンも撮れたとか。
lines.en: I think they said they even managed to film cranes flying along the local railway tracks.
lines.style: Curious, offering up a detail he's been sitting with. Tentative but genuine—not quite a question, but inviting her reaction. Soft at the end.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.en: There's real power in images like that, isn't there.
lines.style: Quiet reflection. Pause before speaking, as if she's just realizing it aloud. Gentle certainty. Not a question despite the intonation—a shared realization, almost to herself.
